descriptions.job-1we8tbt:
Who we are:

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

As a SMB Hunter Sales Manager at Stripe, you will play an instrumental role in fueling Stripe’s growth through new customer acquisition. In this role, you will build and lead a team of high-performing Account Executives, helping them to develop their skills and deliver on their ambitious targets, as well as roll your sleeves up to work directly with customers. We are looking for a proactive leader who has demonstrated success dealing with ambiguity, operating in a high-growth environment, managing high-performing teams and solving complicated problems with limited oversight. Ideal candidates will have management and leadership experience scaling a technology sales team and possess first-class analytical, communication and relationship-building skills.

You will: 

  • Recruit, develop and lead a team of Account Executives who focus on small and medium, high-growth, tech-forward businesses 
  • Work with senior leadership to develop the long-term vision and strategy for the team, and manage day-to-day operations with a focus on performance against key sales and growth metrics
  • Be accountable for increasing revenue and new client acquisition at high rates of growth
  • Coach and guide the team in developing consultative and solution-based sales skills
  • Inspire, motivate and enable development of team members to promote career growth and impact for Stripe 
  • Work collaboratively and cross-functionally across the organization to help shape Stripe’s products and solutions to meet customer needs
  • Play a personal and direct role in building and maintaining enduring customer relationships, up to C-level.
  • Implement programs to improve pipeline generation efforts and improve overall efficiency for the team

We’re looking for someone who has:

  • 8+ years of relevant experience, with 2+ years of people management experience preferred 
  • Experience leading sales in an early stage, high-growth technology environment
  • Ability to hire, train and coach a high-performance sales team
  • Ability to build relationships with strategic client and industry thought leaders
  • Demonstrated passion for start-ups and new technology businesses
  • Ability to understand and articulate technical concepts, and translate them into industry- or business-relevant terms

Nice to haves:

  • Prior experience at a growth stage internet/software company
  • Prior experience forecasting and managing a high growth commercial business
  • Prior experience running complex sales cycles, ideally with both commercial and enterprise size companies
  • Prior experience leading a team in an office outside of the company headquarters
  • Prior experience in the payments industry and/or fintech
descriptions.job-10nl20p:
Flow Traders is seeking a highly capable, experienced and proactive Executive Assistant to support the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) at our Amsterdam HQ. In this pivotal role, you will provide high-level administrative and strategic support directly to the CEO, ensuring the seamless management of the CEO’s day-to-day activities and enabling the CEO to focus on key business priorities and strategic decision-making at a global level. 

You will be a trusted partner to the CEO, taking full ownership of a complex and fast-moving schedule, coordinating a high volume of internal and external engagements, and anticipating needs before they arise. This role requires sound judgement, confidence, discretion and the ability to stay several steps ahead in a dynamic international environment. 


What you will do

  • Manage the CEO’s complex calendar, communications and international travel across multiple time zones
  • Act as a trusted gatekeeper, prioritising competing demands and ensuring the CEO’s time is used effectively
  • Coordinate senior-level meetings, business trips and roadshows, including agendas, itineraries, logistics and briefing materials
  • Anticipate scheduling conflicts and changing priorities, proactively resolving issues and adjusting plans where needed
  • Ensure the CEO is prepared for meetings by coordinating agendas, pre-reads, presentations and other relevant materials
  • Act as a key liaison between the CEO, Management Board, internal teams and external stakeholders
  • Handle confidential and sensitive information with a high level of discretion and professionalism
  • Support board meetings, offsites and strategic or cross-functional projects
  • Manage expenses, invoices and approvals accurately and efficiently
  • Work closely with other Executive Assistants to provide seamless support and coverage
  • Provide flexibility and responsiveness outside standard working hours when required

What you need to succeed

  • A minimum of 5 years working experience as an Executive Assistant
  • Extensive experience supporting a CEO, C-suite or Management Board executive, ideally in financial services, trading or another fast-paced international environment
  • Exceptional calendar management, organisation and prioritisation skills, with experience managing complex schedules and international travel
  • Highly proactive and solutions-oriented, with excellent judgement and the confidence to take initiative independently
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the confidence to work with senior internal and external stakeholders
  • High level of discretion, integrity and professionalism when handling confidential information
  • Calm, adaptable and highly organised, with the ability to manage shifting priorities and work effectively under pressure
  • Strong attention to detail, ownership and follow-through, with a collaborative and hands-on approach
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and collaboration and AI platforms (Claude, Copilot, SharePoint)
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; additional languages are a plus
  • Comfortable working 5 days a week in the office and working flexible hours 

What we offer

At Flow Traders, we create the conditions for hard‑working, high‑performing people to do their best work. From a thorough onboarding and ongoing access to Flow Academy, to latest technology and a collaborative, non‑hierarchical culture, we give you the tools, ownership, and support to move fast and drive outcomes. We keep a close‑knit, small‑company feel while offering competitive salary, annual discretionary profit share, and comprehensive benefits, so talent can grow here, and stay here. See our benefits below:

  • Flow Academy and opportunities to attend domain-related conferences
  • Daily catered lunch, great coffee, and a fully stocked kitchen and snack bar
  • In-house Bar and Lounge with arcade, table tennis, billiards, and game consoles
  • Company boat
  • In-house gym and sessions with personal trainer
  • Bi-weekly massages
  • Annual company trip and a variety of events throughout the year, such as the New Years Event
  • Global rotations across our offices worldwide
  • and more

Flow Traders does not accept unsolicited resumes from any professional staffing or search firms. All resumes, and any other information identifying potential candidates, submitted to any employee at Flow Traders via-email, the Internet or directly without a valid and signed search agreement will be deemed free to contact by Flow Traders without any restrictions and no placement fee of any kind will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Flow Traders.
descriptions.job-0q126nt:
About the position

We are looking for an Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Onboarding Analyst to help our Legal and Compliance team in London with AML and counterparty onboarding matters.

The regulatory landscape within our industry is very complex, and a strong understanding of this—particularly in an AML context—will be essential. You’ll be responsible for onboarding counterparties and conducting any required screenings using third-party vendors. You’ll also be an integral part of our team as we coordinate regulatory filings, complete AML/KYC questionnaires, open new exchange accounts, establish custody banking relationships and perform KYC refreshes.

You’ll have the opportunity to contribute to creating new processes and improving existing ones. The right person for this role will enjoy working with paperwork and people, and be able to answer questions and explain regulations and processes clearly to a wide range of colleagues and external parties.

About you

  • Prior experience in AML or with corporate documentation in a compliance, corporate paralegal, or client services role is preferred
  • The right candidate will be able to independently apply Jane Street’s UK and EU AML policies, and associated internal guidance documents
  • Have some understanding of different financial asset classes, including equities, fixed income, derivatives and FX, and a willingness to learn more
  • Motivated self-starter who can handle competing priorities and work effectively in a challenging, fast-paced environment
  • Organised with excellent attention to detail
  • Strong analytical thinker with good judgement
  • Can communicate clearly with colleagues and external partners
  • Fluent in spoken and written English; foreign language skills are highly desirable

If you're a recruiting agency and want to partner with us, please reach out to agency-partnerships@janestreet.com.
descriptions.job-0pqha7t:
Bitdeer is a world-leading technology company for AI and Bitcoin mining infrastructure.

Bitdeer is committed to providing comprehensive Bitcoin mining solutions for its customers and building AI computational infrastructure to support the AI revolution.

Bitdeer handles complex processes involved in computing such as equipment procurement, transport logistics, data center design and construction, equipment management, and daily operations. Bitdeer also offers advanced cloud capabilities to customers with high demand for artificial intelligence.

Headquartered in Singapore, Bitdeer has deployed data centers across multiple countries, including the United States, Norway, Bhutan, and Ethiopia.

To learn more, visit https://ir.bitdeer.com/

What You Will Be Responsible For
GPU as a Service (GPUaaS) Sales

  • Drive customer acquisition and revenue growth for GPUaaS offerings, including GPU Cloud, bare metal, and dedicated GPU clusters.
  • Develop AI labs, model companies, AI infrastructure companies, cloud providers, and large enterprise customers.
  • Understand customer GPU requirements for training and inference workloads and match them with the right GPU, cluster size, region, and deployment solution.
  • Own the full sales cycle from prospecting and technical evaluation through pricing, contract negotiation, and deployment.
  • Drive large-scale GPU capacity and long-term commitment deals.
  • Work closely with product, infrastructure, engineering, finance, and legal teams to execute complex customer deployments.
  • Build and maintain relationships with CTOs, Heads of Infrastructure, VPs of Engineering, Procurement leaders, and other key decision-makers.

How You Will Stand Out

  • 5+ years of experience in cloud, AI infrastructure, data center, HPC, or enterprise sales.
  • Strong understanding of GPU Cloud, bare metal, and AI training/inference infrastructure.
  • Familiarity with NVIDIA GPU products and the GPU capacity market.
  • Proven experience developing large customers and closing complex B2B deals.
  • Experience with large-scale GPU clusters, AI infrastructure, or long-term capacity deals is preferred.

descriptions.job-1du1309:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Startup SaaS Platform team works with European startups in one of Stripe’s must-win segments. At Stripe, SaaS platforms are companies using Stripe to embed payments and make financial services a core part of their own product, meaning their partnership with Stripe is vital to the success of their business, like Shopify, Mindbody and Lightspeed.

SaaS platforms are a global priority for Stripe, and our team identifies and develops Stripe’s future strategic accounts in Europe. We identify and partner with high-potential companies, helping them leverage Stripe’s solutions to better support their users, scale globally and create new revenue streams through monetisation of payments and financial services. 

What you’ll do

As a Hunter Account Executive on the Startup SaaS Platforms team, you will be instrumental in driving Stripe’s future growth. 

The role will involve prospecting to businesses, articulating the value of Stripe and strategically advising them on how they can optimize their business using Stripe solutions, either for the first time or by expanding their use of Stripe. We guide our users to understand how Stripe’s modern financial infrastructure can support their growth ambitions and provide a competitive edge for their business or product.

Responsibilities

  • Directly manage and cultivate a named account list (New Prospects)) while crafting comprehensive account plans aimed at winning and expanding business with high growth Startups.
  • Understand users' pain points and our value to SaaS platform clients, proposing tailored solutions that consult on their long-term growth.
  • Bring clients through complex evaluations of Stripe’s solutions for SaaS platforms, working with cross-functional teams (Product, Risk, Operations) to successfully follow new projects through to activation and adoption.
  • Foster relationships with executive stakeholders and represent Stripe in the local startup ecosystem to help us grow our footprint and mindshare.
  • Work with other cross-functional teams on shared initiatives to drive internal efficiency and broader business impact.
  • Own the complete sales cycle, from lead generation through to product adoption within the target Startup segment.
  • Develop robust outbound strategies and execute creative prospecting programmes to create and nurture new business opportunities and contribute directly to our GTM priority of driving new logos and accelerating revenue realisation.
  • Identify high-potential prospective startups from inbound leads and dedicated outbound prospecting, collaborating closely with Marketing and Sales Development teams.

Who you are

We’re looking for a curious, well-rounded strategic seller who can build strong relationships with Stripe’s clients in this key segment. You are comfortable owning your territory, balancing a mix of high value, strategic deals with smaller, high velocity deal cycles.

You are solution-oriented, adaptable, have a keen interest in further developing yourself and know how to get things done. You do enjoy a highly-technical sales cycle and working with a diverse group of internal stakeholders.

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in a client-facing/closing sales role
  • Ability to understand complex technical ecosystems
  • Desire to build great relationships, often with technical customers
  • Analytical ability to manage complex sales cycles
  • Experience managing projects with input from cross-functional teams
  • Bias towards team success and knowledge sharing
  • A knack for seeking out and working well with a wide range of stakeholders, both internally and externally
  • Motivation to operate in a highly ambiguous and fluid environment
  • High professional fluency in Spanish and English (Portuguese is a Plus)

Preferred requirements

  • Prior experience in a sales and/or customer-facing role at a high growth technology company
  • Comfort interpreting and discussing API-first solutions
descriptions.job-1nvr4l5:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies, from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups, use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Testability has long been a priority for Stripe. Before users trust code with their money, they need to verify that it’s safe and correct. This need drove Stripe to build test mode and, more recently, Sandboxes, which enables safe, isolated, and scalable testing.

As businesses build with AI and agents, their testing needs are evolving. Stripe customers use claimable sandboxes to add Stripe capabilities to prototypes before business registration. Once onboarded, they provision isolated test environments to support agents’ exploration. These capabilities help developers and agents build and test their integrations with Stripe.

The Sandboxes team defines, builds, and operates these testing capabilities. We work across Stripe to make our products testable, helping businesses develop with confidence and shaping the future of Stripe’s developer platform.

What you’ll do

You’ll lead and grow the Sandboxes engineering team, setting technical direction and operating critical systems. You’ll build a culture of operational excellence and thoughtful product development.

You’ll work directly with users to understand their needs and partner with Product, Design, and Data Science to shape and deliver the team’s strategy. The role combines building reusable testing capabilities across Stripe with attention to the details that make developer tools effective and easy to use.

Responsibilities

  • Lead engineering planning and execution, partnering with Design to build clear, useful testing experiences.
  • Shape the team’s strategy and roadmap, aligning partners across Product, Design, Infrastructure, Marketing, and Operations.
  • Own delivery from problem definition through rollout and ongoing operation, improving both system performance and the user experience.
  • Uphold high engineering standards across the team’s codebases and development practices.
  • Partner with Recruiting to hire engineers and build a diverse, high-performing team.
  • Coach and mentor engineers, provide candid feedback, and support career development tailored to their goals.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, we encourage you to apply.

Minimum requirements

  • 4+ years of engineering management experience, directly managing and growing teams of 5+ engineers building and shipping products at scale.
  • 8+ years of full-time software development experience.
  • Experience building reusable, extensible software that supports a range of user needs, with strong user empathy and a commitment to high-quality user experiences.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, with a track record of finding practical solutions to complex challenges.
  • Experience turning ambiguous goals into clear priorities and delivering multiple high-impact workstreams.
  • A track record of building a supportive environment with candid feedback and high expectations.
  • Technical depth to guide architecture and product design discussions and help engineers make informed tradeoffs.
  • Experience taking ownership of initiatives and moving work forward independently.

Preferred qualifications

  • Strong product and design judgment, including the ability to simplify complex user experiences.
  • Experience making decisions and building strong working relationships across teams.
  • Experience building and leading a distributed team across multiple locations and time zones.
  • Experience building developer tools or platform capabilities.
  • Experience building testing tools or capabilities that help users test within a product.
  • Experience building AI agent systems or tools that support agent-driven development.
descriptions.job-0x4fmih:
About Dune

Dune's mission is to make onchain finance observable. We're the industry standard for onchain data: a blockchain data and intelligence provider that institutions, protocols, and analysts trust to understand the onchain world and the frontiers of finance. We deliver structured datasets, spanning stablecoins, RWAs, tokens, lending, trading, and more, from 130+ chains and counting, to 1,000+ industry leaders including Visa, WisdomTree, FINRA, the IMF, Bloomberg, Standard Chartered, Coinbase, Forbes, and the Financial Times.

We're a tight knit team of ~50 hard working people, spread across Europe and eastern US timezones 🌍️, having an outsized impact on the industry. We take pride in being ambitious and doing world class work while staying humble and lighthearted. We believe in building open, verifiable data that lets individuals and institutions do deep research into ecosystems like Ethereum, Solana, Robinhood and many more.

We're backed by some of the world's best investors. In February 2022, we announced our Series B funding round led by Coatue and Union Square Ventures, an important milestone that let us double down on our mission.

If you like being challenged and want to work together with a brilliant team on an important mission, come join us.

Learn more about us:

About Dune
https://dune.com/about

Values and working at Dune

https://dune.com/careers

About the role

Dune is building market data solutions for institutional customers who need timely, accurate and reliable financial data they can depend on. Our team turns onchain activity into realtime feeds and associated reference data along with historical data capture.

You will work on our new market data platform, and help shape how it evolves to support the growing features and customer base. You’ll design systems that can grow across chains, protocols and product capabilities while making clear decisions about correctness, latency, reliability, and cost.

This is a hands-on Staff Engineer role. You will be expected to turn ambiguous requirements into designs and deliverable work, implement difficult parts yourself, and help other engineers own meaningful parts of the platform. AI-assisted development is a core part of how we expect you to work, paired with strong engineering judgment and ownership of what you ship.

In this role you will

  • Design and build distributed systems for ingestion, normalization, processing, storage, and delivery of realtime market data from blockchain and other relevant sources.

  • Build and operate streaming solutions that handle event ordering, timestamps, duplicates, replay, gaps, and recovery, including blockchain reorganizations and finality where they affect customer data.

  • Build reliable client feeds and APIs with clear delivery contracts, schema evolution, access controls, and predictable behavior under load or when consumers fall behind.

  • Partner with teams across Dune on reference data models and historical data capture.

  • Define and improve service objectives and data quality measures.

  • Instrument latency, freshness, completeness, and correctness, and turn incidents into lasting improvements in recovery and operations.

  • You will debug independently and drive root cause analysis to a fix that holds.

  • Own services through deployment and production support, including participation in the team’s on-call rotation.

  • Use AI throughout development: explore designs, implement changes, build tests, investigate failures, and improve documentation. Develop repeatable workflows and share what works with the team.

  • Lead technical decisions across team boundaries, write clear designs, and mentor engineers through implementation and review.

You might be a great fit if

  • You have built and operated distributed backend or data services with demanding reliability and performance requirements. You understand their failure modes and can debug problems across service and data boundaries.

  • You have experience with realtime streaming systems, including concurrency, state management, backpressure, and recovery. You care about data correctness, from timestamps and numeric precision to schema changes and corrections.

  • You have strong computer science fundamentals and backend engineering skills. Experience in Rust, Go or comparable languages is also valuable.

  • You turn ambiguous requirements into pragmatic designs and production services, and help other engineers deliver parts of the solution.

  • You communicate clearly in writing and work effectively with a distributed team.

  • Financial or market data experience at a financial institution.

Not required but a plus

  • Onchain data experience: blockchain indexing such as with EVM or Solana.

  • Reference data experience: instrument and entity masters, identifier mapping, effective-dated records, or tokenized asset and fund data.

  • Experience at a company where the data is the product.



Perks & Benefits

  • A competitive salary and equity package 🚀. Both salary and equity is top 25% of companies in the space

  • Our employee equity scheme has world-class employee-friendly terms with a heavily discounted strike price (~90%) and a 10-year exercise window

  • 5 weeks PTO + local public holidays (that can be swapped to suit you) 🏖

  • A fully remote-first approach 🧑‍💻 within a distributed team with flexible working hours; you structure your own day 

  • Say goodbye to meeting overload! We believe in a healthy mix of async and sync work, so you can focus on what truly matters—no more wasted time on endless meetings!

  • Good health is important, so we offer private medical insurance, dental & vision as standard 🩺

  • We believe in paid parental leave 👶 to help you celebrate this important milestone, transition to your new life, and bond with your new baby. We offer 16 weeks to primary and 6 weeks to secondary caregivers, fully paid. Plus a 2-week part-time phased return at full pay to help you get used to your new (and slightly more complex!) schedule

  • Quarterly offsites in various exciting locations as a company or team to connect, work together and have fun (so far in Tuscany 🇮🇹 Berlin 🇩🇪 Austria 🇦🇹 and Athens 🇬🇷).

  • On top of this 👆each person gets a yearly travel allowance to connect and co-work with someone or a team of people for a few days.

  • An allowance for your at-home setup, to ensure you are happy, comfortable and productive. If you prefer a local co-working space, we’ll pay for your desk.

  • An annual allowance for your Learning and Development needs.

  • Work with some of the best people you’ll ever get to meet!

  • And of course, you get some awesome Dune swag! ✌️😎

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.
descriptions.job-162sss9:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

The Role

Global Seller Onboarding Specialists manage the final stages of the sales funnel, working with US merchants to drive the deal through to activation and accelerate the onboarding process. Global Seller Onboarding Specialists use deep product and industry knowledge to project-manage the onboarding stage of the sales process.  They’ll be responsible for and guiding sellers through the discovery and onboarding journey and ensuring that sellers are optimally scoped, educated, set up and trained to leverage the potential of Square’s platform. They are additionally instrumental in ensuring the documentation and tracking of feature requests to inform future product roadmaps. This is a customer-facing role that involves a combination of remote and onsite merchant interactions. 

A successful Implementation Specialists will: (1) provide an incredible onboarding experience for Sellers, (2) accelerate the sales cycle by specialising onboarding and training, (3) develop new efficiencies to shorten the onboarding sales stage, and (4) support Square’s international expansion efforts. 

You Will

  • Drive world-class onboarding and implementation experiences for Square’s sellers, ensuring accountability to go-live timelines and accelerating deal velocity wherever possible.
  • Cultivate strong cross-functional relationships with Sales, Account Management, Customer Success, Engineering, and Product to align on the seller journey, remove barriers, and deliver faster outcomes.
  • Anticipate and resolve obstacles by managing stakeholder communications and developing scalable strategies that drive consistent success.
    Master Square’s platform, products, integrations, and ecosystem, staying ahead of new features and releases to serve as a trusted subject-matter expert.
  • Lead high-impact, multi-merchant projects with competing priorities, ensuring effective resource allocation and timely delivery.
  • Create and maintain engaging training materials for both internal teams and external partners.
  • Execute accurate data entry and migration tasks for select sellers as part of the onboarding process

Your typical day will include:

  • Remote merchant work: virtual consultation calls and training, advising on hardware/software/operations, staff training, menu building, and hardware installation. 
  • Occasional onsite merchant work, including training and hardware install.
  • Data Entry: configure customer account, optimise menu setup, and other data entry tasks involved in getting a merchant onboard.

You Have

  • BA/BS degree, preferably 
  • 4-5+ years of experience in a customer facing role, preferably in software implementation, support, sales/account management or customer success. 
  • An infectiously positive attitude, as well as a desire to perform at a high level on a continuous basis, and uplift the team around you.
  • Bias for action; performance driven with the confidence to operate independently.
  • Ability to thrive within ambiguity and operate independently.
  • Ability to drive and manage multiple cross-functional initiatives simultaneously; strong time management, and excellent written & verbal communication skills.
  • Proven track record of success in delivering multiple complex projects in the technology industry while partnering with external and internal clients to attain deliverables. 
  • An ability to learn quickly as new products and organisational changes are released.
  • Previous Project Management experience is expected. 
  • Experience in the POS, Payments or Tech industries is a plus.
  • Experience in hardware installation and network configuration is a plus.
  • Must be located in PST/MST time zone.
  • Must be bilingual in English and Spanish.

descriptions.job-0j28ol5:
About Bitdeer:

Bitdeer is a world-leading technology company for Bitcoin mining and AI cloud.

Bitdeer is committed to providing comprehensive Bitcoin mining solutions for its customers. Apart from designing industry-leading ASIC chips and manufacturing mining rigs, the Group handles complex processes involved in computing across the value chain. This includes equipment procurement, transport logistics, datacenter design and construction, equipment management, and network and facility operations. Bitdeer also offers advanced cloud capabilities to customers with a high demand for artificial intelligence.

Headquartered in Singapore, Bitdeer operates globally with a diversified 3 GW energy portfolio, and deploys Bitcoin mining and HPC datacenters.

What you will be responsible for:

Bitdeer is seeking a Senior Analyst, Project Finance to support financing and fundraising for GPU computing and data-center infrastructure. descriptions.job-1fjz7w9:
At Breeze, we're building the AI-powered infrastructure layer for global commerce, making it radically simpler for businesses to sell, get paid, and operate across markets.

We go far beyond traditional payment processing. Breeze combines global payments, AI, stablecoins, and a Merchant of Record-like model to take on the complexity businesses typically manage themselves, including compliance, risk, fraud, chargebacks, reconciliation, and customer support.

Our goal is simple: let businesses focus on building and selling great products while Breeze handles the complexity behind getting paid.

Backed by Sequoia Capital, Multicoin Capital, and The Chainsmokers, Breeze is a successful, rapidly growing, and exceptionally well-capitalized company. We have the runway to think long term while remaining early enough that every person joining today can have a meaningful impact on what we build.

We’re looking for a Enterprise Account Executive who knows how to turn complex opportunities into meaningful revenue and wants to play a key role in Breeze’s next stage of growth. This is an opportunity to help build out our EU Sales team. This is an individual contributor role responsible for a quota. 

You’ll own the sales cycle from first conversation through close, building relationships with high-value prospects, breaking into strategic accounts, and helping companies rethink how they move money. This is a role with real ownership and plenty of room to make your mark. You’ll have the autonomy to build your pipeline, shape your approach, and work closely with Product and Marketing to influence how we go to market.

We’re looking for someone with sharp commercial instincts who can build trust quickly, navigate complex deals, and create a compelling reason for customers to choose Breeze.

If you’re a builder and a closer who loves opening doors, winning meaningful business, and helping scale an ambitious fintech, we’d love to meet you.
This role will be hybrid in our Amsterdam office once finalized. 

What You’ll Do

  • Own the full sales cycle from strategic prospecting through close, building pipeline and winning high-value business across the US
  • Break into key accounts through thoughtful outbound strategies that engage the right decision-makers and create new opportunities
  • Turn customer challenges into compelling solutions, tailoring your pitch and positioning Breeze’s value to each prospect’s business
  • Build the case for change, creating urgency, challenging incumbents, and showing prospects why Breeze is the better choice
  • Help shape how Breeze wins, bringing customer and market insights back to Product and Marketing to sharpen our GTM strategy and influence what we build next

What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience
  • 7+ years of B2B closing experience, ideally across payments, fintech, gaming, or related technology sectors
  • A proven closer with a track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets and winning complex, high-value mid-market or enterprise deals
  • A strategic seller who can navigate multiple stakeholders, build compelling business cases, create urgency, negotiate effectively, and close at the executive level
  • An exceptional communicator who builds trust quickly and can turn complex solutions into clear, tailored, and compelling pitches
  • A self-starter with startup grit who takes ownership, moves quickly, and adapts as priorities and opportunities evolve

Our Compensation Philosophy!

We believe compensation should be fair, competitive, consistent, and transparent. We benchmark compensation against the market and establish thoughtful bands for each role, with compensation reflecting experience, skills, location, role scope, and expected impact. We don't believe pay should primarily depend on how aggressively someone negotiates. Eligible employees receive meaningful equity, so the people building Breeze can participate in the long-term value they help create.

Benefits & Perks

  • PTO: 21 days, plus applicable company holidays.
  • Equity: Meaningful ownership in the company you're helping build.
  • Equipment: A new MacBook Air and whatever else you need to do your best work.
  • Office & education allowance: An annual budget for your workspace, tools, and professional development.
  • Wellness: A monthly reimbursement to support your well-being.
  • Annual global offsite: We bring the global Breeze team together every year. Previous destinations include Bali and Singapore, with Japan coming next.

Breeze is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion or creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship or immigration status, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, marital or partnership status, caregiver status, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status, height or weight, sexual and reproductive health decisions, status as a victim of domestic violence, sexual violence, or stalking, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Breeze considers qualified applicants with criminal histories in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws, including the New York City Fair Chance Act, where applicable.

Why Join Breeze

  • Make an outsized impact: We're successful and still early, with meaningful traction and strong financial foundations. Lean teams, few layers, and direct access to decision-makers mean you'll have real ownership and the autonomy to make things happen.
  • Solve hard, meaningful problems: Work at the intersection of AI, payments, stablecoins, risk, compliance, financial infrastructure, and global commerce as we build an intelligent infrastructure layer that goes far beyond payments.
  • Build AI-first: AI isn't an add-on. It's central to how we're building our products and how our teams operate. You'll experiment with new tools, automate the repetitive, and continuously rethink how to work smarter.
  • Work with an exceptional team: Join ambitious, curious, low-ego people who move quickly, hold a high bar, and care deeply about what they build.
  • Grow with Breeze: As Breeze grows, strong performers can quickly expand their scope and take on bigger problems.
  • Build for the long term: Backed by Sequoia Capital, Multicoin Capital, and The Chainsmokers, we're exceptionally well-capitalized with the runway to think big.

In-Office Expectations

Employees based in our New York City, NY office follow a hybrid work model and are expected to work from the office three days per week. Employees based in our Singapore office are expected to work on-site five days per week.

In-office expectations may vary slightly depending on role, team, and business needs. Certain roles that require closer cross-functional collaboration or operational support may have additional requirements, which will be discussed during the interview process.

Our approach is designed to support meaningful in-person collaboration, team building, and real-time decision-making while providing flexibility where applicable. We believe this structure enables strong execution, close collaboration, and effective teamwork across our global offices.

Come Build With Us!

We offer a rare combination: the ownership and speed of an early-stage company with the traction, backing, and financial foundations of a successful business.

We're building at the convergence of AI, payments, stablecoins, financial infrastructure, and global commerce. The opportunity is much bigger than building another payment processor.

We're building the intelligent infrastructure layer for global commerce, and there's still an enormous amount left to build.

If you want meaningful ownership, hard problems, exceptional teammates, and the opportunity to help define what comes next, we'd love to hear from you!

descriptions.job-1axbwft:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies, from the world’s largest enterprises to ambitious startups, use Stripe to accept payments, manage their businesses, and grow their revenue. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a significant amount of work ahead. You’ll have an opportunity to help put the global economy within everyone’s reach. 

About the team

The Foreign Exchange team builds the products and infrastructure that help Stripe users operate across currencies. Businesses increasingly operate globally from the moment they launch, collecting revenue, holding balances, paying suppliers, and managing expenses across multiple currencies.

Managing those currencies remains fragmented. Finance teams must decide what to hold, when to convert, how to manage currency exposure, and how to reconcile the results. Today, these workflows often span banks, spreadsheets, treasury systems, and specialist FX providers.

Stripe is uniquely positioned to simplify this. We sit at the center of the payments, Billing, balances, payouts, and settlement flows that create a business’s currency needs. Our vision is to make Stripe the financial home for businesses operating internationally, with a unified offering for holding, converting, and managing currencies and FX risk.

A core part of this vision is making currency management agentic. We believe software agents will increasingly help businesses understand their FX position, recommend actions, and manage currencies within defined policies and controls.

This could include Stripe-native agents that monitor exposure and take approved actions. It could also mean enabling customers’ own agents to use Stripe’s infrastructure to understand balances and exposures, obtain pricing, execute conversions or hedges, and reconcile the results.

Our goal is to make Stripe the currency-management layer that both people and agents can build on.

We will build these capabilities both for globally operating businesses and for the platforms and marketplaces that use Connect.

What you’ll do

We’re looking for a Product Manager to build a new area of Stripe’s FX and currency-management offering. This is a zero-to-one product role at the intersection of FX, treasury, and agentic AI. You will help define what agentic currency management should look like. That could mean Stripe-native agents that understand exposure, recommend actions, and execute within customer-defined policies. It could also mean enabling customers’ own agents to use Stripe’s FX infrastructure to understand balances, obtain pricing, manage risk, execute transactions, and reconcile the results.

You will work directly with globally operating businesses to understand their most important currency-management problems. You will identify the right initial product wedge and take it from discovery through launch and iteration. Today, treasury teams assemble exposures from multiple systems, determine hedge requirements, monitor changing positions, request pricing, execute trades, and reconcile the results. We believe much of this workflow can become continuous, intelligent, and increasingly automated.

You might build products that combine Stripe’s real-time view of payments, balances, and settlement activity with customer forecasts and policies to identify exposures and recommend actions. You might also define the APIs, permissions, controls, and financial primitives that allow customer or third-party agents to safely take those actions through Stripe.

Over time, these systems could move from surfacing insights to requesting quotes, executing conversions or hedges, rebalancing positions, and escalating exceptions within clearly defined permissions.

You will determine which intelligence Stripe should provide directly, which capabilities we should expose for others to build on, where humans should remain in the decision loop, and how we evaluate whether agents are making good decisions. Your product area could also include automated conversion and balance policies, recurring currency-management workflows, or capabilities distributed through Connect.

The opportunity is broad. Your job will be to make it focused. You will determine where Stripe can create differentiated value, build the first product, measure whether it works, and use those learnings to shape the roadmap.

You will work closely with Engineering and Design on product experiences, APIs, data models, agent behavior, controls, and system reliability. You will also partner with Treasury, Risk, Legal, Finance, Sales, and Product Marketing to ensure the products are economically sound, operationally scalable, and ready for customers.

Responsibilities

  • Deeply understand how global businesses and platforms manage currencies, including holding, converting, forecasting, hedging, and reconciliation.
  • Own the strategy, roadmap, and success metrics for a focused area of Stripe’s FX and currency-management offering.
  • Identify high-value customer problems and take new products from discovery through launch, adoption, and iteration.
  • Define Stripe’s approach to agentic currency management, including Stripe-native experiences, agent-ready APIs, permissions, controls, and evaluation.
  • Partner closely with Engineering and Design to build simple, reliable products across user experiences, APIs, data models, and financial infrastructure.
  • Work across Treasury, Risk, Legal, Finance, Sales, and Product Marketing to ensure products are economically sound, operationally scalable, and successful with customers.
  • Use customer insights and product results to shape Stripe’s broader FX and currency-management strategy.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. Preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including taking technically complex products from problem definition through launch and iteration.
  • Demonstrated ability to turn ambiguous customer problems into clear product strategies and focused roadmaps.
  • Experience building financial infrastructure, enterprise software, APIs, regulated products, AI-native products, or similarly complex systems.
  • Strong technical judgment and experience partnering with engineers on APIs, data flows, reliability, and system behavior.
  • Strong customer instincts and experience translating complex financial or operational workflows into simple, scalable products.
  • Strong analytical judgment and ability to make decisions with incomplete information.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain product decisions, risks, and tradeoffs across technical and nontechnical teams.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with foreign exchange, multi-currency products, treasury, cross-border money movement, hedging, or financial risk management.
  • Experience building AI-native or agentic products, especially systems that can recommend or take actions within defined controls.
  • Experience building products for finance or treasury teams at globally operating businesses.
  • Experience with API-first, configurable, or automated financial products.
  • Familiarity with the economics, accounting, liquidity, regulatory, or operational considerations involved in FX products.

About Mantle

We’re building an AI agent to help families support their aging parents (origin story here).

 

Over 40M “sandwich generation” Americans currently manage their parent’s affairs. Keeping mom/dad safe and supported is like a second job: it’s time-consuming, stressful and on top of their already busy lives. We believe that managing our parents’ affairs should feel under control, easier and lower stress.

 

Co-founded by serial entrepreneur partners including Ted Zagat, who sold his previous businesses to Slack (announcement here) and Google (Zagat restaurant guides).

The Role

We are looking for a Customer Support Lead to be the voice of Mantle for the families we serve. Behind every family is a real situation, and when they reach out, they need someone who is fast, warm and genuinely helpful. You will work side-by-side with the founders, product and engineering to make sure every family gets real results, and turn what you learn into a better product.

This is a role for a builder. In the early days, you'll be answering tickets, onboarding families and handling tricky situations yourself. It's not just about support; it's about the unglamorous work of documenting every issue, writing the playbooks, and spotting the patterns that let us fix problems at the source. You'll be the one doing the manual work today so we can build the support systems, and the AI, of tomorrow.

What You'll Build

  • Support function: Stand up the tools, processes and service standards for supporting Mantle's families.

  • Family onboarding: Help new families get set up and get value from Mantle quickly.

  • Help center and playbooks: Create the documentation that answers common questions and guides how we handle complex ones.

  • AI partnership: Review and improve how our AI agent handles conversations, and define when a human needs to step in.

  • Voice of the customer: Bring what families need back into our product and roadmap.

  • Support analytics: Track response times, satisfaction and top issues, and drive them in the right direction.

What We're Looking For

Required Experience

  • 4+ years of customer support or customer experience experience, ideally at a consumer startup or high-growth company

  • Experience supporting customers through complex or sensitive situations with empathy and good judgment

  • Hands-on experience with support tools (e.g. Zendesk, Intercom, Front)

  • Track record of building processes and documentation from scratch

  • Excellent written communication

  • AI adept: savvy with AI tools (LLMs, agents) to increase your own personal leverage

Ideal Background

  • Early-stage startup experience, ideally as the first support or customer experience hire

  • Experience supporting a subscription or financial product

  • Experience working alongside AI support tools or reviewing AI-generated responses

  • Personal experience helping a parent or family member manage their affairs

  • Nice to have, but not required: experience with FinTech

Who Thrives Here

  • Builders: You love creating things from scratch and taking full ownership

  • Empathetic: You meet families where they are, especially on hard days

  • Systems-minded: You turn every solved problem into a better process

  • Great collaborator: You foster great working relationships

  • AI-forward: You embrace modern AI

  • Autonomous: You thrive with minimal direction

  • Mission-driven: You care about what we're building

What You'll Get

  • Meaningful work: Help real families with some of the most important moments in their lives, with fast pace and huge financial potential

  • Founding scope: Shape how Mantle supports families from the very beginning

  • Partnership with founders: Work closely with Mantle's co-founders and other company leaders

  • Learning & growth: Opportunity to build a category-defining company from the ground up

  • Real ownership: Your insight will directly shape our product, business and culture

  • Remote Fridays: Work from home every Friday. Monday through Thursday, we build together in person in San Francisco
